cases.why: Latin abbreviations are said in English

cases.said: Lights, for example the porch; tonight, that is after 9, and fans et cetera

cases.why: a number sign is 'number'

cases.why: comparison and approximation signs are said
cases.said: Battery plus or minus 2 percent, about 40 gigabytes, CPU at least 90 percent, latency at most 5 milliseconds, 3 not equal to 4.

cases.why: a fraction before a noun is a quantity
cases.written: Add 1/2 cup and 3/4 of the stock.
cases.said: Add a half cup and three quarters of the stock.

cases.why: a fraction that is a score stays a score
cases.said: Scored 3 out of 4.

cases.why: a letter after a number and a space is a word, not a unit
cases.written: Two 3 A grades and a 10A breaker on 12V.
cases.said: Two 3 A grades and a 10 amps breaker on 12 volts.

cases.why: short time units are said in full
cases.written: About 3 hrs, then 1 hr, 5 mins, 1 min and 10 sec.
cases.said: About 3 hours, then 1 hour, 5 minutes, 1 minute and 10 seconds.

cases.why: what the table does not know stays: acronyms and an ampersand inside a word

cases.said: R&D is up 12 percent YoY in Q3.
